title_en: Supreme People's Court and Supreme People's Procuratorate Joint Notice on the Scope of Application of the Subject of Crime as Stipulated in Article 114 of the Criminal Law
full_text_en:
Joint Notice of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate on the Scope of Application of the Subject of Crime Stipulated in Article 114 of the Criminal Law

[86] Gao Jian Hui (Er) Zi No. 10

To the High People's Courts, People's Procuratorates of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; Military Courts, Military Procuratorates; Railway Transport High Court, National Railway Transport Procuratorate:

Recently, some state-owned and collective enterprises and institutions, as well as cooperative business organizations and individual businesses, have continuously experienced major liability accidents resulting in casualties and property losses due to neglect of safety in production. In order to ensure personal safety and reduce economic losses, in addition to relevant departments strengthening education on safety in production, major liability accidents must be seriously investigated and dealt with. If the circumstances are serious, violate the criminal law, and have constituted a crime, criminal liability must be pursued in accordance with the law.

The subject of crime for major liability accidents under Article 114 of the Criminal Law includes not only employees of state-owned and collective factories, mines, forest farms, construction enterprises, or other enterprises and institutions, but also personnel of cooperative business organizations or individual businesses. Where the person in charge of a cooperative business organization or an individual business is derelict of duty in management work, causing a major accident with casualties and serious consequences, criminal liability shall also be pursued in accordance with the provisions of Article 114 of the Criminal Law.

June 21, 1986
